north_star.title: Live 0→1 for Q1
north_star.statement: An external agent client installs the TWZRD buyer gate and honors block before the wallet signs — proven by gate_evals and refuse transcripts, not by free MCP hits.

phases.label: 01 · Truth
phases.subtitle: Separate live infra from live demand
phases.outcome: One north-star metric board that only counts external demand.

phases.label: 02 · Wedge
phases.subtitle: Path B is the product, not preflight alone
phases.outcome: Every install demo ends with refuse-before-sign (signer=0).

phases.label: 03 · Proof
phases.subtitle: Make the gate dogfoodable in under 5 minutes
phases.outcome: A cold machine can prove Path B without a wallet or USDC.

phases.label: 04 · Distribution
phases.subtitle: Put the gate where agents already pay
phases.outcome: 3 embed seats live + weekly outbound that creates gate_evals.

phases.label: 05 · Convert
phases.subtitle: Free card → gate install → optional V6 proof
phases.outcome: First external paid trust + first external gate_evals > 0.

moves.title: Pin external-only Day0 on the wall
moves.why: Health already separates free_card_hits_external from internal swarm. If you manage to total hits, you will celebrate dogfood and miss that demand is near zero.
how: Dashboard tile: free_card_hits_external, gate_evals, paid_trust_payer_external only.
Never report free_card_hits_internal in investor/partner decks.
Add a weekly screenshot of /health day0.door_zero with external basis.
moves.metric: Team can recite external free cards, gate_evals, paid_trust_external from memory

moves.title: Declare Path B north star for Q1
moves.why: Preflight is advisory. Paid V6 is portable proof. Neither is enforcement. Live 0→1 means a client honors block before signTransaction.
how: Write one sentence: Success = external gate_evals with signer_invocation_count=0 on refuse.
Secondary: external free cards. Tertiary: paid_trust_payer_external.
Kill any metric that rewards internal template alias hits.
moves.metric: gate_evals (external) is the only primary OKR

moves.title: Lead every conversation with refuse-before-sign
moves.why: MCP tools and free preflight create awareness but do not block spend. The install that refuses is the wedge competitors cannot soft-ship as a dashboard.
how: Hero line: Before your agent signs, TWZRD can refuse.
Demo order: refuse fixture → gate eval → transcript with signer=0.
Only then show MCP / merchant_card / V6 as supporting rails.
moves.metric: 100% of partner demos show Path B first

moves.title: Freeze a one-screen message hierarchy
moves.why: Current surfaces list 24 tools, settle rails, market data, and watch hooks. 0→1 needs a single sentence and a single install path.
how: Primary: Machine trust for autonomous spend — block before sign.
Proof: npm i twzrd-x402-gate + refuse eval binary.
Optional: hosted MCP for discovery; V6 only after trust is enforced.
moves.metric: One paragraph + one command on every surface (intel, X, Smithery blurb)

moves.title: Cold-machine Path B under 5 minutes
moves.why: Optional peers of the gate are not auto-installed. Broken first runs kill distribution. Q1 lives or dies on frictionless dogfood.
how: Publish a single copy-paste block that installs gate + peers + runs refuse eval.
Record expected: signer_invocation_count=0 payment_retry_count=0.
File every break report as a P0 until the script is green on a fresh machine.
moves.metric: 3 independent people complete refuse proof without help

moves.title: Ship a public refuse transcript artifact
moves.why: Screenshots of allow/warn cards look like every other trust API. A refuse transcript is unique and shareable.
how: Commit a sanitized JSON transcript from twzrd-gate-eval-refuse.
Pin it on X + README with the install one-liner.
Invite partners: run this and paste your signer_invocation_count.
moves.metric: At least 5 public replies/forks with signer=0

moves.title: Win 3 embed seats where x402 clients already live
moves.why: You cannot out-content Coinbase AgentKit, OpenClaw, or Claude Code install bases. You must be a default onBeforePayment hook inside them.
how: AgentKit / x402 clients: keep registeredServices + README example warm.
OpenClaw / ClawHub skill: default preflight plugin with enforce mode docs.
One framework adapter (eliza / facilitator) with a public reference agent.
moves.metric: 3 embed docs live that mention installTwzrdAutoGate or equivalent

moves.title: Close 5 design-partner agent operators
moves.why: External free cards at ~30 with zero gate_evals means discovery without install. Operators who already lose USDC to bad counterparties feel the pain.
how: Target: Solana x402 buyers who run recurring agent spend (multi_merchant cohort exists on corpus).
Offer: white-glove gate install + shadow mode for 14 days, then enforce.
Success: their gate_evals show on health (even if fail-open is off).
moves.metric: 5 LOIs or shipped installs; ≥1 external gate_eval/day

moves.title: Weekly refuse-demo outbound rhythm
moves.why: Infra that is live but quiet dies. Outbound must force Path B, not link spam to /llms.txt.
how: 2 demos/week to agent frameworks, facilitators, and x402 merchants.
Each demo ends with them running the refuse binary themselves.
Log outcome: no-show / ran proof / installed / gate_eval observed.
moves.metric: 8 demos/month with ≥50% completing refuse proof live

moves.title: Instrument free → gate → paid as a real funnel
moves.why: door_zero already sketches grade → free card → paid. 0→1 needs gate install as the missing middle.
how: Event: preflight (external) → gate package download / eval hit → gate_eval → optional V6.
If free cards grow but gate_evals stay 0, messaging is wrong — fix demos, not ads.
Do not optimize paid V6 until gate_evals move; paid is proof, not enforcement.
moves.metric: Funnel chart reviewed weekly; gate_evals is middle stage

moves.title: Earn first paid_trust_payer_external
moves.why: Zero paid external trust means no one bought portable proof. Useful signal after gate installs exist — portable receipt for downstream agents.
how: After design partner gate is live, offer V6 as audit trail for compliance / multi-agent handoff.
Price already set (0.05 USDC) — do not change price; change why they need a receipt.
Verify with offline twzrd-receipt-verifier in the same session.

moves.title: Keep settle_gate in shadow until Path B has demand
moves.why: settle_gate_enforcing=false is correct for 0→1. Enforcing seller screens before you have buyer-gate installs confuses the wedge.
how: Leave settle gate in shadow; log only.
Spend Q1 cycles on buyer AutoGate installs, not facilitator policy surface area.
Revisit enforce only after external gate_evals are healthy.
moves.metric: No premature settle_gate_enforcing=true without gate demand

day0.free_card_attribution_note: external is the only demand-bearing number here; internal is our own swarm/tooling and unattributed is context-free, never external
day0.portable_proof_upsell_note: merchant_card path only, interim in-memory counter (per-worker, non-durable, resets on restart) — the preflight path's impressions are durable, see preflight_requests.portable_proof_upsell_trigger instead
day0.paid_trust_payer_note: external = EXTERNAL_VERIFIED_WALLETS only (completed lineage audit); internal = INTERNAL_WALLETS / dogfood; unknown = unknown_pending_audit (default for anything new — never counted as external). Use paid_trust_payer_external for organic conversion, not raw paid_trust_total.

door_zero.note: door-zero funnel: process-local mechanism usage; NOT external adoption (metric stays counted_external guard runs)

live.diagnosis: Advisory demand exists without enforcement. Free cards are happening; nobody has installed the buyer gate. Lead with refuse-before-sign.

thesis.headline: Own the rails that put every Cloudflare Agent on Solana.
thesis.subcopy: Cloudflare owns agent distribution. Solana owns settlement speed. SPRAT by TWZRD is the trust + x402 facilitator middle.

decision.summary: Hold engineering on Agents MCP SVM. Flood live x402-hono Solana path. MCP-SVM is watch + optional read-only spike only — not build-now.
ship_now: Public monorepo docs: examples/cloudflare-x402-seller README + CF_AGENTS_SOLANA.md (#1924/#1925/#1928)
do_not: Re-probe Signal B weekly as if it is the product
Build cloudflare/agents SVM fork this week without a go/no-go spike
Claim generational moat or facilitator monopoly
Treat paid MCP Solana as unblocked
Reopen #596 as pure Solana enhancement without multi-scheme framing

return: Issue strategy: attach #1863 not reopen #596; check #1989 deprecation risk
Gas cost model if MCP Solana hits TWZRD sponsor
if_spike_later.preferred_ship_shape_if_go: Companion package first (usable without CF merge) + optional upstream PR sketch

github_agents_context.596: closed NOT_PLANNED — pure Solana MCP enhancement rejected once
github_agents_context.793: closed completed — v2 migrate; body mentioned future Solana; stopped at EVM
github_agents_context.1863: open bug — docs claim multi-chain; code EVM-only; multi-scheme + type widen design (Stellar-focused but same hole)
github_agents_context.1989: open — deprecating current x402 integration toward Monetization Gateway (raises merge risk for patches to mcp/x402.ts)

signal_b_probe_correction.register_api: ExactSvmScheme class + registerExactSvmScheme on exact/server and exact/client (mirror EVM paths)
signal_b_probe_correction.grep_hint: Prefer ExactSvmScheme or @x402/svm — not only registerExactSvmScheme function name
fires_when: SVM scheme registered on BOTH server and client in agents MCP x402 module
Solana appears in MCP network map / types
not_enough: TWZRD facilitator feePayers mainnet Solana (already true)

agent.name: SPRAT Agent
agent.role: Solana Payment Rails for Agent Traffic
agent.mission: Convert Cloudflare agent demand into Solana settlement volume with TWZRD as the default trust + facilitator supplier.
weapons: x402-hono Workers path (live, public workers.dev proof)
Passive watch on MCP SVM + CF Wallets API — no speculative build

supply_lanes.name: Workers Solana sell
supply_lanes.detail: x402-hono + TWZRD facilitator on mainnet USDC. Only Solana-capable CF surface today.

supply_lanes.name: Agents MCP @x402/svm
supply_lanes.detail: Agents MCP still EVM-only. Foundation @x402/svm exists; CF has not registered it. #1989 may replace mcp/x402.ts. No engineering this week.

supply_lanes.name: Cloudflare Wallets API
supply_lanes.detail: Handle reservation live; Virtual Wallet API still coming.

supply_lanes.name: CF token mint policy
supply_lanes.detail: Per-job token policy ready. CF_WORKERS_DEPLOY_TOKEN separate from CF_API_TOKEN analytics.

A.label: cf-wallets-api
A.fires_when: Stable documentable Virtual Wallet API with create/list/fund ops.
A.watch: Stable Virtual Wallet API — no speculative CF Wallets scopes until then

B.label: mcp-x402-svm
B.fires_when: Agents MCP registers SVM scheme on both server and client; Solana in network map; changelog mentions Solana/SVM x402.
B.probe_hint: grep ExactSvmScheme or @x402/svm (scheme package is class-based, Foundation-complete at 2.21.0)
B.watch: registerExactSvm / @x402/svm on both sides; #1863 open, #596 NOT_PLANNED, #1989 deprecation risk

posture.guardrail: Flood Solana volume through live Workers + x402-hono + intel facilitator. Do not pre-build speculative CF Wallets scopes. Do not engineer Agents MCP SVM this week without an explicit spike go. Signal B is not product until CF registers SVM (or you ship a companion package after a written go/no-go).

cf_strategy.company_sentence: Scarcity for paying agents isn’t chain access — it’s a machine-readable *should I pay this?*, free at the top, enforced at the wallet hook, monetized as portable proof.
